roles.title: Senior Executive Assistant
roles.summary: I've been retained by the CEO of one of the world's leading technology companies to identify a Senior Executive Assistant in Austin, Texas. This is one of the most significant Executive Assistant opportunities currently in the market, supporting a CEO who is widely considered one of the most impactful leaders of our time.

roles.title: Executive Assistant
roles.summary: We are searching for an experienced Executive Assistant to support the two founders of a boutique private equity firm focused on the life sciences sector, based in Chicago. This is a classic dual-principal EA role, requiring a seasoned operator who can run two demanding diaries in parallel, anticipate the rhythm of a founder-led investment firm, and provide the calm, consistent backbone that allows both principals to operate at full capacity.

roles.title: Analyst, Office of the CEO (VP)
roles.summary: Blackbook Associates is retained on an Analyst search within the Office of the CEO at a large alternative asset manager headquartered in New York. This is a high-impact, decision-support role designed to strengthen the analytical engine around the CEO. This is not a CEO-facing administrative or scheduling role.

roles.title: Chief of Staff
roles.summary: Blackbook Associates is retained on a Chief of Staff search for a multi-family office in New York. This is a technical Chief of Staff role supporting the founder directly across investment activity, portfolio oversight, and the strategic operations of the firm.

roles.title: Senior Executive Assistant
roles.summary: A rare and confidential mandate at one of the most recognised names in the hedge fund industry - a firm that genuinely sits at the top of its market. This is a principally business-focused EA role, supporting the principal across his commercial life. A separate PA covers the personal side, though some natural crossover sits between the two.

roles.title: Analyst, Office of the CEO
roles.summary: A well-funded, scaling fintech with a proven product, a growing enterprise customer base, and serious momentum. The Chief of Staff drives strategy and cross-functional execution. The EA manages access, logistics, and the operating rhythm. The Analyst owns the information layer.

roles.title: Executive Assistant to Founder
roles.summary: You will be the primary point of coordination for a Founding Partner who splits his time between Philadelphia and Belgium, and a CFO based in New Jersey. The Founding Partner requires more intensive day-to-day support; the CFO needs sharp coordination, travel management, and someone who can chase information and move things forward on his behalf.
